entities.summary: Khitan Liao, a notable figure in the history of North Korea, associated with Goryeo Dynasty (993–1019). Preceded by Goryeo-Khitan Wars. Their legacy influenced General Gang Gam-chan annihilates the Khitan army at the Battle of Gwiju and Mongol Invasions of Goryeo.
